_readme: Pre-publication removal checklist for a REAL bilateral dispute fixture. Every item is a hard gate: if any box cannot be checked TRUE with evidence, the fixture is NOT publishable. Run examples/real-fixture-intake/prelude.mjs for the machine-checkable subset; items marked (HUMAN) require a written answer from the intake operator and cannot be decided by a script.

machineChecks.signaturesAreSignaturesOnly: EIP-712 r/s/v/digest fields are expected and allowed; any other 32-byte hex blob in a non-signature field must be justified in notes

scopeResponseItems._readme: The removed-data answers that correspond to the disclosure scope signed in consent-template.json section B_disclosureScope (crossChecks). The gate checks consent ↔ checklist consistency; the operator fills both from the same review session.
scopeResponseItems.secretsRemovedConfirmed: Everything the secret scanner hunts was removed; re-run examples/real-fixture-intake/prelude.mjs until GATE GREEN
scopeResponseItems.personalDataRemovedConfirmed: All humanChecks items below answered and applied (names, emails, entities, third-party data, URLs)
scopeResponseItems.redactionCompletePerChecklist: Every machineChecks box TRUE and every humanChecks item resolved in writing
scopeResponseItems.checklistRef: This checklist: DDE-REAL-INTAKE-REMOVAL-v1 for the same caseRef — referenced by the signed scope

humanChecks.partiesPseudonymizedAddresses: HUMAN — replace party names, emails, legal entity names with the wallet addresses the parties consent to publish; keep role labels (client/provider) only
humanChecks.offChainArtifactsRedacted: HUMAN — delivered artifacts often embed names/logos/paths/user data; redact content, then re-pin SHA-256 in delivery-manifest.json
humanChecks.amountsDisclosureDecision: HUMAN — decide and record: keep exact wei, or round to magnitude (e.g. '≈0.25 ETH'); amounts are often commercially sensitive
humanChecks.urlsAndEndpoints: HUMAN — internal hostnames, signed URLs, IPFS gateway tokens must be stripped
humanChecks.timestampsConsidered: HUMAN — timestamps alone rarely identify parties, but confirm with the parties before publishing exact values
humanChecks.thirdPartyData: HUMAN — artifacts or records referencing OTHER people/companies (not the two parties) must be removed or generalized

signOff.operatorRole: intake operator — not a party to the dispute
